installers.description: Copy the nossaifd skill into a target repository and record the source revision in .agents/nossaifd-install.json.

required.name: python3
required.description: Runs the checker, which needs Python 3.11 or later.

optional.name: git
optional.description: Records the source revision of an install.

npx.install: npx skills add rahuldave/nossaifd -a codex --skill nossaifd -y
